newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma recedes, forwards soft in long periods.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma recedes, forwards soft in long periods.

text.p: Greek depos were stable at low levels but forex forwards were easier in longer periods, bonds were steady and ECU/drachma lost ground on ECU sales for drachmas by banks in late trade, dealers said.
"There is liquidity but the central bank did not cut its intervention bid rate and depos and forex forwards idled at lower levels," dealers said.
Uncertainty over tax issues continued to depress activity in the secondary bond market with bond prices little changed, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 156.35/45 drachmas from Tuesday's 261.050 fix, the dollar at 260.88/98 drachmas from 156.365 and the ECU at 304.37/47 from 304.400 drachmas.
